title: Story premise ENT033: The Printer-Paper Waterfall
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: The floor arrives one sheet at a time. Takeaway/theme: A moving obstacle can sometimes supply the route.
description: A paper-sized messenger must carry a seal across a desk before a harmless sheet dispenser fills it with blank pages. They surf one outgoing page, leap into its curling edge, and arrive on the destination tray inside a perfectly folded paper pocket.
